assets.name: Appendix source Figure 1
structures_observed: Caecum and terminal ileum: source-labelled nearby landmarks
assets.caption: Source-labelled normal appendix on longitudinal ultrasound, with a 0.3 cm measurement and nearby caecum and terminal ileum markers. This still image provides a local reference; it does not demonstrate graded compressibility or the entire base-to-tip course.
assets.limitations: The original PDF embeds modest-resolution clinical figures (approximately 494 pixels wide at 150 dpi). No DICOM series, validated full course, complete attachment geometry, dynamic compression or 3D reconstruction is supplied. Original labels and measurements are preserved; they are not independent measurement validation. Age, sex and laterality are unreported. The source legend distinguishes psoas and rectus stars, but the star glyphs appear similar; those muscle labels cannot be independently distinguished at this resolution.

assets.name: Appendix source Figure 3
structures_observed: Appendix and surrounding inflammatory changes described by the source; precise CT localization review pending
assets.caption: Paired imaging of a 45-year-old man with source-diagnosed acute appendicitis. Ultrasound a shows only part of the appendix; contrast-enhanced CT b is described as showing appendiceal thickening, surrounding mesenteric infiltration and sigmoid inflammation. The CT panel has no structure-specific arrows; precise anatomical localization remains unreviewed.
assets.limitations: The original PDF embeds modest-resolution clinical figures (approximately 494 pixels wide at 150 dpi). No DICOM series, validated full course, complete attachment geometry, dynamic compression or 3D reconstruction is supplied. Original labels and measurements are preserved; they are not independent measurement validation. US a is not CT evidence. The CT panel lacks structure-specific arrows; a detailed anatomical localization review remains pending.
